title: Rental Contract Without Viewing
scenario: A landlord sends a contract and asks for deposit because they are overseas.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Rental Contract Without Viewing: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Overseas landlord stories are common rental-scam signals.
